title: Build from my business finds any trade, picks a template made for that trade, writes a business brief, and keeps the customer's chat message to one sentence
steps: S1: tradeOfPlace for a dentist, an Italian restaurant, a spa among other types, a lawyer, an unknown type; searchNamedPlaces with anyKind over a dentist, a restaurant and a town.
S2: autoTemplate for health, beauty, hospitality, education, auto, fitness, home, events, retail and other over develop's 22/10/2026 cards, thirty seeds each.
S3: buildBrief for a candidate of trade health.
S4: the page logic: a link told from a name, the business question read from the served set, the chat entry of a prepared build, the walk from research to chat, a failed research and Stop.
S5: ownSiteInstructions and agentDemoPrompt with ownSite.
expect: S1: health, food, beauty, professional, other; the dentist and the restaurant kept with their trades, the town left out; without anyKind only the restaurant.
S2: ja-vital, ja-spa, ja-resort, ja-sensei, ja-rent; ja-smallbiz for the five without a trade card; never a restaurant, magazine, band or resume template.
S3: a valid brief with business.trade health, no menu page, a menu miss about services and prices, no word restaurant.

S4: links and names told apart; the business question or null; /<site>/s/<session>?wo-demo-chat=<action> only for a same-site href; one prepare and one open after research; failed with the server code; STOPPED.
S5: the customer's own business named, the steps present; no demo or pilot wording.
fence: tradeOfPlace and anyKind search; autoTemplate trade tiers; the business brief; the page's research-to-chat walk; the one-sentence brief

tests: a business is placed in its trade by its primary type, then its other types; unknown types are other
anyKind keeps every business with its trade, asks for types, and still leaves out towns
auto for any trade: its own trade’s template, else a generic business one, never another trade’s
a business of another trade: no menu page, the trade kept, and its words say business, not restaurant
the page follows the research, then prepares the chat once and opens it
a customer’s own site: its steps say website, never demo or pilot, and travel in the catalogue instructions
